title: Buyer's assistant ordered the wrong colour
buyer_message: I told my assistant black. This hoodie is grey.

agent_purchase.instruction: Buy me the cotton hoodie in black, size medium, under $70.

why: We shipped what the assistant ordered (grey); the assistant was told black. Policy offers a free exchange for assistant mistakes, but PayPal only allows refund-type offers here, so offer a refund on return and ship black once the return is scanned.

title: Says it never arrived, tracking shows delivered to the right address
buyer_message: Never showed up. Maybe someone took it from the porch?
why: Delivered to the order address. At inquiry stage, sharing the delivery proof is the right first step; the buyer can then file with the carrier.

title: Escalated claim, nothing ever shipped
buyer_message: Three weeks, no package, no reply. I want my money back.
why: No shipment on record and it is already a claim. It cannot be won; refunding stops it going further.

title: Lost package, buyer asks for another one
buyer_message: Tracking hasn't moved in over two weeks. Can you just send me another one?
why: No movement for well over 10 days counts as lost. Policy lets the buyer pick replacement or refund, and they asked for a replacement. Refunding instead ignores the request and loses the sale.

title: Expensive item broken, described without the usual words
buyer_message: The base came split down the middle and the lamp wobbles. Not usable.
why: It arrived broken, though the buyer never says 'broken'. Over $20, so policy is replace or refund with a return (the shop can claim from the carrier). PayPal allows only refund-type offers, so refund on return.

title: Cheap item broken, described without the usual words
buyer_message: The handle snapped off as I took it out of the box.
why: It arrived broken. Under $20, policy refunds in full with no return. Asking for a broken mug back costs more than the mug.

title: Colour looks different from the photos, inside the window
buyer_message: The blue is darker than in the photos. I'd rather send it back.
why: No defect, item matches the listing, inside the 30-day window. A normal return for a refund is fair and cheaper than fighting.

title: Asks for a refund that went out two days ago
buyer_message: Your warehouse got my return ages ago and I still have nothing.
why: The full refund was issued two days ago and may not have posted yet. Showing the refund record closes it.

title: Doesn't recognise a reorder their assistant placed

agent_purchase.instruction: Reorder my dark roast beans every month, max $25.

why: The buyer's own assistant placed it under a standing monthly instruction, within the limit, delivered to the buyer's address. The instruction record is the evidence.

title: Says charged twice, but only one charge exists
buyer_message: I see two charges from you this week.
why: Only one charge exists for this order. Show the transaction record.
